description: This file contains a mock implementation of the IClusterMembershipService interface used for unit testing within the Orleans framework. It manages cluster membership snapshots, updates silo statuses, and provides mechanisms to simulate cluster membership changes.

classes.name: MockClusterMembershipService
classes.description: A mock implementation of IClusterMembershipService for testing purposes, managing cluster membership snapshots and updates.

methods.name: UpdateSiloStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and name of a specified silo and publishes a new cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: ToSnapshot
methods.description: Converts the current statuses dictionary into a ClusterMembershipSnapshot with a specified version.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the cluster membership, currently a no-op.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Attempts to kill a specified silo; not implemented in this mock.
